name: chip
title: Chip
summary: A monospace chip for a code value in text or a table.
description: A monospace chip for a code value in prose or a table: a field name, a command, a version. Monospace token chip for code values like `updated_at`. Inline: it sits on the text baseline, and a long value wraps with the sentence instead of overflowing.

notes: Rendered as <code>, so it is announced as code. Tone is decoration; never the only carrier of meaning.
